goals.goal: Chase the healthcare pursuits now turned down, for two more wins a year
goals.quote: So if we chased those, two more wins a year feels realistic.

goals.goal: One screen on Monday showing every pursuit due, its owner, addenda and fee sign-off
goals.quote: Monday morning, I open one screen and I can see every pursuit that's due in the next two weeks, who owns it, whether an addendum came in, and whether the fee's signed off.

goals.goal: No more missed submissions, and write-offs coming down
goals.quote: No more missed submissions, and write-offs coming down.

goals.goal: Des Moines opens on the same system as everyone else, not its own spreadsheets
goals.quote: And I'd add, Des Moines opening on the same system as everyone else, not its own set of spreadsheets.
